repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate reverses the subtraction order in the condition. The IR requires ($v1 - $v2) >= 20, meaning the volume must drop (v1 > v2). The candidate uses (v2 - v1 >= 20), which triggers when volume rises (v2 > v1). Evidence F2 shows the action fired at t=300000ms because v2 (20) - v1 (0) = 20, whereas the IR condition (0 - 20) = -20 fails.
diagnosis.change_summary: Reversed the operands in the `if` condition from (v2 - v1) to (v1 - v2) to match the IR's logic for detecting a volume drop.
